scope: Fresh official-source feature-group inventory, not exhaustive control coverage or runtime certification. Supported means bounded implementation observed in Wing source; unsupported means missing outcome, not a claim that upstream lacks it; unverified means incomplete semantic/contract/qualification evidence. Every named-target runtime cell remains not_run.
source_paths_relative_to: read-only hermes-agent checkout; physical location may differ in an isolated Wing worktree
test_lead_boundary: Official test files are inspection leads, not executed upstream tests. Some assertions were inspected; file presence alone never qualifies behavior.
runtime_evidence_rule: Advance a target cell only with source/build/driver/target identity, exact operations and authoritative readback from that named target. Fixtures, code graphs, compilation and unrelated old receipts cannot advance these cells.

features.current_wing_subset: Wing adaptive semantics and text/keyboard paths exist, without full named-target assistive-technology qualification.
features.remaining_gap: Deeper official focus/close ownership and non-spatial equivalents remain unverified. Screen size fixtures are not native accessibility evidence.

linux_native.acceptance: Run native status accessibility candidate, then actual keyboard-only and screen-reader traversal at 200% text/reduced motion; verify visible focus, escape and no pointer-only path.

android.acceptance: On physical Android use TalkBack, large text, switch/hardware keyboard and reduced motion through connection/chat/approval/Settings; audio/spatial/color cannot be sole channels.

features.outcome: Session import overlay

reference.observed: Official session import overlay is a distinct route and implementation, not equivalent to generic backup/import.

features.current_wing_subset: No Wing session-import destination.
features.remaining_gap: Parse/preview/commit and Agent authority, conflict/idempotency/security need deeper tracing; no local history seeding.

linux_native.acceptance: Verify unavailable import; future Linux journey must use an exact supported Agent operation with preview/cancel, duplicate prevention and authoritative session readback.

android.acceptance: Verify unavailable import; future Android file-picker/import must test cancellation and owner changes without sending cached history as a new conversation.

features.outcome: Starmap learning/history visualization

reference.observed: Official Starmap is a registered overlay backed by visualization components; playback/share/context-menu internals are not fully traced.

features.current_wing_subset: No equivalent Wing Starmap destination.
features.remaining_gap: Do not substitute retired Office/3D or claim source imports prove accessible visualization behavior.

linux_native.acceptance: Verify unavailable Starmap; future Linux implementation must match authoritative data and provide non-canvas keyboard/list access, share consent and source-bound playback tests.

android.acceptance: Verify unavailable Starmap; future Android equivalent must work with TalkBack/large text without spatial gestures or motion and preserve profile/source identity.

features.outcome: Guided setup conversation and loading handoff

reference.observed: Guide loading is a dedicated presentation component; ready-session identity, saved handoff and full onboarding sequence need deeper controller tracing.

features.current_wing_subset: Wing welcome/manual setup does not implement the official guide conversation.
features.remaining_gap: No fabricated greeting/progress or early composer; guide resume/skip and free-tier effects remain unverified.

linux_native.acceptance: Verify welcome is not advertised as guide parity; future Linux guide must wait for its actual saved session and preserve that session on restart/skip/failure.

android.acceptance: Verify manual Termux help is not a guide conversation; future Android guide requires accessible loading, authoritative session handoff and no automatic Send or hidden enrollment.

features.outcome: Bundled contributions and runtime plugin loading

reference.observed: Bundled plugins are discovered and activated per saved/default enablement; inventory includes Bots, optional Kanban, Radio and Hello runtime. Activation is not proof of each interaction.

features.current_wing_subset: No equivalent Wing contribution/runtime-plugin system.
features.remaining_gap: Do not invent a Flutter plugin ABI or port Electron internals. Radio/Hello-specific routes/actions and plugin settings require semantic tracing before admission as implemented outcomes.

linux_native.acceptance: Verify absent plugin loader; future Linux work must trace an actual official outcome and authoritative scope first, then test enable/disable/dispose without stale UI or machine authority.

android.acceptance: Verify no arbitrary code/plugin installation is implied on Android; any future equivalent needs platform-appropriate safe behavior and exact supported contracts.
